videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay is called upon to piece together a vintage ceramic night light; skateboard enthusiast Mike is hoping Will and Dominic can restore his wooden board; Julie and Amanda undertake the repair of a treasured teddy bear.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Toy restorers Amanda and Julie work on two well-loved dolls; Dominic and Tim work together to fix up a rusty posterior-powered bucking bronco bicycle.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Julyan rebuilds a family's heritage banjo; Lucia preserves a speedway racing bib for a daredevil's granddaughter; Amanda and Julie mend a rag doll that keeps the memory of a woman's late little sister alive.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Amanda and Julie give new life to a beloved, 90-year-old toy bear that evaded the Gestapo; Dom and Suzie take on a rusty, tattered set of golf clubs and nurse a tick-tocking wall clock back to life with Steve.

videos.description: Suzie and Will pool their talents to rejuvenate a leather-stitching stool; Dom and Sonnaz test-drive a renewed recliner for a nostalgic daughter; Steve gets a frog-shaped clock running again.

videos.description: Jayesh smartens up a faded, threadbare magician's hat for a young trickster; Dom opens an artist's time capsule; a multidisciplinary team does CPR on a mechanical model of a butcher that's on the blink.

videos.description: The team takes on the challenge of restoring a set of unglazed clay sculptures that reminds its owner of her beloved late brother, a vintage lawnmower, and a handmade leather horse from the Second World War.
